svg.aria-label: connect.md. A private, browser-only builder for portable professional Markdown. A person or their agent drafts a profile or resume, validates it, previews the sanitized Markdown and downloads the file. No account and no upload. Shown as a Markdown page that writes itself line by line while a person and an agent orbit it.
